name: idc-rider-pilot
description: This data collection was originally supported under supplemental funding for the Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) U01 project and focused on the collection of longitudinal studies using X-ray CT for monitoring the response to therapy. The data came primarily from the M.D. Anderson Cancer Center and several of the LIDC academic sites. The data is not annotated. A small subset of the data (8 subjects) which were analyzed in QIBA-VolCT-1B have been re-released on TCIA. Please see the RIDER Pilot page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
